claim_key_policy: Each claim key expresses one exact proposition. Website operating activity and UK dormant-account filings are retained as separate facts because they can coexist under an unknown multi-office or multi-entity operating structure.
limitations: Owned-site team, advisory-board and office scale is self-reported and was not employment-verified.
The accessible Companies House filing-history extract establishes dormant accounts through June 2024, not the nature of the June 2025 accounts.
No revenue, budget, contract value, buyer identity, signing authority, analytics or authenticated operational data was established.
The African Business Chamber source corroborates Agnes Gitau's external role and positioning, not GBS Africa revenue or client outcomes.
not_approved_as_fact: That GBS Africa has nine employees or occupies both published offices.
That the UK dormant filings mean the wider advisory brand is inactive or has no revenue.
That improved citability will create enquiries, partnerships, contracts or revenue.
Any contract value, budget, procurement authority or named buyer.
That every published client logo represents a current engagement.

commercial_reasoning.statement: The approved evidence supports moderate commercial fit and high execution readiness for a small research-citability pilot. Commercial impact remains unknown and cannot be promised.
